# Axis One

> Axis One is capital governance infrastructure operated by AX1 Structura Ltd. It connects committed capital to current milestones, attributable evidence, explicit authority and controlled decision states.

Axis One is non-custodial. It does not hold, transfer, settle, manage or guarantee client capital, and it does not replace the authorised human decision-maker. Public programme interfaces are illustrative and are not customer data.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/): Product position, decision test, governance architecture and Decision Brief.
- [System](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/system): How execution, evidence, validation, authority and decision records connect.
- [Decision exposure](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/capital): Directional exposure calculator, methodology and independently attributed industry context.
- [Deployment](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/deployment): AX1.Pilot, AX1.Core and AX1.Enterprise engagement scopes.
- [Trust](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/trust): Permissioned access, product boundaries, collaboration model and current security position.
- [Founder](https://ax1-website.pages.dev/founder): Tania Jokic and the operating problem behind Axis One.
